_readme: Overrides for the auto-synced project list. See README.md → 'How to add a project'.

tab-teacher.long: A practice app for learning guitar solos. Pick a song from the menu and work through the solo with the tab in front of you. Built because I wanted it for my own practicing.

SphericalVoronoi.long: Voronoi diagrams, but on the surface of a sphere instead of a flat plane. Seed points split the globe into cells, each one holding everything closer to its seed than to any other.

private.title: The Paw
private.blurb: The website for Denver Jewish Day School's student newspaper, with a CMS so editors can publish without code.
private.long: The website for Denver Jewish Day School's student newspaper, which I created. Readers get a fast static site with sections, an archive with search, staff pages and an RSS feed. Editors get a CMS (Keystatic) so they can publish without touching code.

private.blurb: AP Lang essay practice with AI-generated prompts, AI grading, XP, badges and a global leaderboard.
